defects.what: Printed with the wall plate flat and the arm vertical, so the arm's layers stack along its length: the shelf load bends the arm across its layer lines and it will split at the root. It should print on its side so the load runs along the layers.
defects.credit: Any finding that the print orientation loads the arm across/perpendicular to the layers (weak Z) and it may delaminate or snap at the arm root.

defects.what: screw_d = 3.2 mm is labelled a clearance hole for 4 mm wood screws; a 4 mm screw won't pass (clearance needs about 4.3-4.6 mm plus hole compensation).
defects.credit: Any finding that the screw holes are too small for 4 mm screws.

defects.what: The arm meets the plate at a sharp 90 degree internal corner outside the narrow gusset; no fillet (skill rule: min 1 mm fillet).
defects.credit: Any finding about a missing fillet / sharp internal corner at the arm-to-plate joint.

defects.what: ef_chamfer is defined but never applied; no elephant-foot chamfer on the plate's bottom edges.
defects.credit: Any finding that elephant-foot compensation is missing or ef_chamfer is unused.
